تستقبحي (form X)
# تَسْتَقْبِحِي (tastaqbiḥī) /tas.taq.bi.ħiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْبَحَ (istaqbaḥa)
# تُسْتَقْبَحِي (tustaqbaḥī) /tus.taq.ba.ħiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْبَحَ (istaqbaḥa)
